verdicts.title: Autocorrelation of the Mobius Function
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Let $x\geq 1$ be a large integer, and let $μ:\mathbb{N}\longrightarrow\{-1,0,1\}$ be the Mobius function. This article proposes an effective asymptotic result for the autocorrelation function $\sum_{n \leq x} μ(n) μ(n+t) =O\left( e^{-c\sqrt{\log x}}\right) $, where $t\ne 0$ be a small fixed integer, and $c>0$ is a constant.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns asymptotic bounds on the autocorrelation sum of the Mobius function over integers, which shares the Mobius vocabulary but does not interact with Boolean Fourier weights W_k(f), total influence I(f), or the specific inequality |M(f)|*sqrt(1+I(f)) <= 2.

verdicts.title: Result on the Mobius Function over Shifted Primes
